profile.inheritance.title: GICS profile inheritance
profile.inheritance.subtitle: Directed graph (tree) of defaults with child overrides
profile.inheritance.description: Defaults are inherited from parent nodes (sector → industry group → industry → sub-industry). Each child can add metrics, override thresholds, or remove (veto) inherited metrics. If there is no more specific node, the parent defaults apply.
profile.inheritance.rule.dedupe: Category dedupe rule: core > risk > secondary (each metric belongs to exactly one category per node).
